taskDescription: Arrange the steps of the enzymatic antioxidant relay in the correct order, from superoxide generation to glutathione regeneration.

sequenceImages.imageDescription: Mitochondrial electron leak generating superoxide at Complex I
SOD converts two superoxide radicals to hydrogen peroxide and oxygen
Glutathione peroxidase reduces hydrogen peroxide to water using GSH
Glutathione reductase regenerates GSH from GSSG using NADPH from the HMP shunt

l10n.score: You got @score of @total points. This sequence illustrates the SOD-GPx-glutathione reductase pathway in a mitochondria-containing cell. Mature red cells lack mitochondria and depend on the HMP shunt for NADPH. G6PD deficiency limits GSH regeneration during oxidant stress, making them susceptible to haemolysis.
